_comment: Example MCP client configuration for pulse-mcp. Copy the relevant block into your client's config file.
notes: Replace /absolute/path/to/pulse-mcp-bridge/index.js with the real path on your machine.
MOBILE_PHONE_IP should be the local Wi-Fi IP address of the phone running the mobile app (see mobile-app-server.js).
If you installed pulse-mcp globally via npm link / npm i -g, you can use "command": "pulse-mcp" instead of node + args.
